name: CheckConstraint
description:
CheckConstraint validates a single record with a CEL expression on
 every insert and update.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Constraint name, unique within the collection.

fields.name: Expression
fields.description: CEL expression that must evaluate true for the record to be written.

fields.name: When
fields.description: Optional CEL gate: the check applies only when this evaluates true.

fields.name: Message
fields.description:
Error message returned on violation, written to be relayed to an
 end user by an agent.
